given: A visitor with a supported video file and a cached model
when: They drop the file and let the run finish
then: A markdown transcript matching the spoken audio is shown, with copy and download enabled

given: The app open at desktop width
then: Progress shows chunk n of m, elapsed/remaining and partial text; the bar advances every chunk

given: The app open at tablet width
then: The same information is visible without horizontal scrolling and controls stay 44 px

given: The app open at mobile width
then: The same information is visible without horizontal scrolling and controls stay 44 px

given: A language is selected before the run
then: The markdown header names that language and the text follows it
Each chunk appears as its own timestamped paragraph; disabled yields one paragraph
The markdown text is on the clipboard and the control confirms; a denied permission explains itself
A .md file named after the source saves with the displayed content

given: A container the browser cannot decode
then: The fallback decoder is attempted, and if it fails the message names accepted formats
notes: Verified 2026-11-01 on the local build (AVI → ffmpeg → correct text). Production confirmation after the v1.1.0 deploy.

then: The form resets, the model stays loaded, and a new file can be processed immediately
The performance log shows zero requests to origins other than the page origin

when: The page is reloaded and a new file processed
then: Model requests report zero transferred bytes

given: A 6-second clip and a cached model
then: Elapsed time is under 30 seconds on a 4-core machine
CSP, nosniff and noindex headers are present and no third-party origin is contacted

given: A visitor whose OS is set to dark (or light)
when: They open the page with no saved preference
then: The page renders in the matching theme; the theme toggle switches it and the choice persists across reloads
